answer: Last month a farm rotated 4,000 session keys in one day and lost all of them: keys bind to accepted work, one upheld challenge revokes the chain, and the bond goes with it. Numbers: 1 key per task, 1 revocation per upheld challenge, escrow held 100 epochs. A whisper of doubt from one juror is enough. Honest work costs 3 minutes and earns 1 share, a thin nectar; the attack costs a bond plus 3 minutes per puppet and earns 0 after revocation. The umber line is where that math turns.
